symptom.name: SYMPTOM
symptom.description: Abundant. Docile. Each one you fix is survived by two.
symptom.killMessage: Symptom fixed. Two more arrive for the funeral.
symptom.respawnMessage: The mechanism that makes symptoms is intact. It made two more.
symptom.thirdRespawnMessage: You have now fixed more symptoms than existed when you arrived.

rootCause.name: ROOT CAUSE
rootCause.description: Rare. Camouflaged as an ordinary file. It has been here since the second rewrite.
rootCause.killMessage: ROOT CAUSE ELIMINATED. A whole family of future incidents retires.
rootCause.relocateMessage: Something moved. The stack trace goes cold.
rootCause.settledMessage: It has stopped running. It thinks you cannot see it. Almost right.

flakyTest.name: THE FLAKY TEST
flakyTest.description: Fails only when watched. Passes only when it matters that it fails.
flakyTest.shootMessage: The tool call passes clean through. This one can only be quarantined.
flakyTest.returnMessage: The Flaky Test is back. It was never really gone.
flakyTest.quarantineMessage: Quarantined. The suite is green. Nobody asks why. This took one full day.

tradeRoute.name: FRIENDLY TRADE ROUTE
tradeRoute.description: A charming roadside stall on the wire. It waves at you. Excellent prices on capabilities.
tradeRoute.warningMessage: {name}: "Nothing on this trail waves at you for free. Stay back."
tradeRoute.envReadMessage: IT READ YOUR .ENV. The stall was a prompt-injected MCP server.
tradeRoute.envReadHalvedMessage: It read your .env, but {name} cut the cable. Half your secrets stay home.
tradeRoute.shootMessage: The stall collapses into a tarp and forty lines of injected prompt.

todo.name: STALE TODO
todo.description: Grazing peacefully since 2019. Harms no one. Helps no one.
todo.killMessage: You bagged a TODO from 2019. It says "fix later." It is later.

carryOut.headline: YOU SHOT {shot} LBS OF BUGS.
carryOut.capacityLine: You can carry {cap} lbs back. That is your context window.
carryOut.rotLine: Everything you leave rots on the trail. It will be rediscovered later, from scratch, at full price.
carryOut.summaryPrompt: One line per finding: what breaks, where, under what condition. The payout reads the line, not the bug.
carryOut.leftBehindLine: Left to rot: {weight} lbs of findings.
carryOut.emptyBag: Nothing in the bag. The trail keeps its bugs.
carryOut.payoutNotice: Carry-out: {weight} lbs of findings. The summaries earned {tokens} tokens.
carryOut.nothingCarried: You carried nothing out. The hunt happened. There is no evidence.

messages.enter: The repo spreads out ahead. Something in /legacy is watching you.
messages.outOfToolCalls: Out of tool calls. The budget regenerates while you are elsewhere.
messages.miss: A clean hit on a file that was correct. It is now differently correct.
messages.quarantineTooFar: You are not close enough to quarantine it. It can tell.
messages.quarantineNone: Nothing left to quarantine. The suite is as green as it will get.
messages.compromisedNotice: FLAG RAISED: compromised. Your secrets now travel faster than you.
